title: Windows Vista Speech Recognition Tested - Perl Scripting
summary: A 2007 video of someone trying to write Perl scripts using Windows Vista speech recognition, with comically bad results. The footage shows the recognizer repeatedly mangling commands.
why: Cited as the classic, unintentionally hilarious example of early voice recognition failing, and of how dictation used to feel.

quote.text: the video absolutely captured what it felt like to use those products
